description: Which congressional budget resolutions (concurrent resolutions on the budget, H.Con.Res. / S.Con.Res.) exist for a federal fiscal year, and how far each got: adopted by both chambers, passed one chamber, or only introduced. Use for "was a budget resolution adopted for FY2024?", "what budget resolutions were there for FY2027?". A year with no resolution returns found:false with a named reason, not an empty list. Covers fiscal years 1994 onward (bill text starts with the 103rd Congress). Source: U.S. Congress, as published by the U.S. Government Publishing Office.

fiscal_year.description: Federal fiscal year (Oct-Sep), e.g. 2025 = Oct 2024 through Sep 2025.
